teaser: A lamp left burning, in a room everyone else has gone from, is close to a portrait of life path 11 crossed with INFJ. Both run on a current of insight that doesn't wait for permission. The number pushes toward being a conduit people lean on without quite knowing why; the type already builds its days around noticing what others miss. Crossed, that hum rarely settles. What's particular here isn't the intuition itself — plenty of numbers and types claim some version of that — it's the doubled demand to use it well, carry it quietly, and still show up rested for dinner.
excerpt: Noticing arrives before words do, most times.
